PROGRAM zcv_resume_inline.

* Every resumed tail lands in one resume method, so the same inline DATA
* after a popup in two FORMs or two modules must take distinct names there.
DATA gv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.

MODULE first INPUT.
  PERFORM ask_first.
  PERFORM ask_second.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Module?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = gv_answer.
  DATA(lv_text) = |Module: { gv_answer }|.
  MESSAGE lv_text TYPE 'S'.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE second INPUT.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Again?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = gv_answer.
  DATA(lv_text) = 1.
  gv_answer = lv_text.
ENDMODULE.

FORM ask_first.
  DATA lv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'First?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = lv_answer.
  DATA(lv_text) = |First: { lv_answer }|.
  MESSAGE lv_text TYPE 'S'.
ENDFORM.

FORM ask_second.
  DATA lv_answer TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      text_question = 'Second?'
    IMPORTING
      answer        = lv_answer.
  DATA(lv_text) = strlen( lv_answer ).
  MESSAGE |{ lv_text }| TYPE 'S'.
ENDFORM.
